method: Soak the oats in the milk for 10 minutes. ¦ Beat in the egg and the baking powder until smooth. ¦ Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat. ¦ Pour in ¼ cup batter for each pancake and cook 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden.
rewrite: Leave the oats to soak in the milk 10 minutes. ¦ Whisk the egg and baking powder into them until the batter is smooth. ¦ Melt the butter over medium heat in a frying pan. ¦ For each pancake, pour ¼ pint batter into the pan and fry it 2 to 3 minutes on each side, until golden.
rewriteDescription: Oat Pancakes, made with rolled oats, milk and egg.
